title: Clicknow: Unlimited LLM Access for Less Than $20
summary: Clicknow's most unique feature that you might not believe
author: laike9m
body_html:
ChatGPT changes everything, not just technology, but also business.

Before ChatGPT, people would think carefully before subscribing to a $20/month service. Now in 2025, $20/month has become an industry standard for LLM services, and we seem to take it for granted. What's even worse? Many LLM wrappers, despite requiring customers to bring their own API keys, still charge them $5 ~ $20 dollars a month. To me, this is unacceptable.

In the good old days, most software used the pay-once use forever model. They didn't have subscriptions, because it didn't make sense. Clicknow shares the same idea. We believe one-time payment works best for customers, and it works best for our business.

To take it one step further, Clicknow is one of the few LLM tools that don't require an API key. It has its own.

After installing Clicknow, you can start using it right away. This is particularly helpful for people who have trouble paying for ChatGPT/Claude/etc, due to not having supported payment methods, or who live in regions that these services don't support.

In case you wonder if this model is sustainable, I once shared the billing with everyone: Clicknow's API fee is less than $1 per month, since Gemini flash models are surprisingly cheap. So yes, it is sustainable, and I'm happy we can do it this way to make our users' life easier.

title: Two-way translation（中英文互译）
summary: Clicknow auto picks the best target translation language. For text in your native language, it's translated to your preferred 2nd language (e.g. English)
author: laike9m
body_html:
Clicknow is a handy tool for anyone who needs to work with foreign languages. Today, we're making Clicknow even more useful, introducing Two-way translation.

How It Works

Let's say you're a native Chinese speaker, but you need to work with English. Previously, you set "Translate to" to Simplified Chinese (简体中文). Now, you can set "Second language" to English

(Note: You can pick any two languages, not just Chinese and English)

Clicknow automatically detects the language when you perform text selection:

  1. If the selected text is not Chinese, it will be translate to Chinese (the "translate-to" language);
  2. If it is Chinese, it will be translate to English (the second language)

This allows people to work with their native and second language seamlessly.

Example

I'm still using Chinese-English as an example, but it works for any language combination.

Oh, did I mention you can replace the original text with its translation with one click? 😉

title: Custom models (OpenAI, Claude, Deepseek)  are now supported 🎉
summary: Starting today, you can specify the preferred model to use (with your own API key) in Clicknow
author: laike9m
body_html:
Clicknow is a unique AI tool as it comes with its own API key, and you can start using it right after download. By default, it uses Gemini to handle translation and explanation (and Perplexity for online searching). While this is handy, many customers still want to be able choose a different model and use their own API key.

Today, I'm happy to announce that this is possible. Starting version 1.15, Clicknow supports the following models:

  • GPT-4
  • GPT-4 Turbo
  • Claude 3.5 Sonnet
  • Claude 3.5 Haiku
  • Claude 3.7 Sonnet
  • DeepSeek V3
  • DeepSeek R1

To use these models, you need to provide an API key.

If you want to use a model that's not in the list, please let me know in r/ClicknowAI and I'll be happy to support it.

title: PopClip Clicknow extension
summary: You can open Clicknow from PopClip with one click
author: laike9m
body_html:
Starting from 1.14.6, Clicknow provides a native PopClip extension! Once installed, it works just like another PopClip button. Here's how it looks like:

Installation

Installing the extension is super easy

  1. Make sure you've installed Clicknow and PopClip;
  2. Download the extension
  3. Double click the downloaded file clicknow.popcliptxt to install

You should be able to see Clicknow appear as a PopClip extension 😀

How do I disable Clicknow's popup, and only leave PopClip's?

Once you installed the extension, most likely you only want one popup.

You can do so easily but turning off Clicknow from the status bar, then you'll only see PopClip's popup. You can still use the extension and activate Clicknow as needed. 

Do I still need the Clicknow app if I installed the PopClip extension?

First, the PopClip extension just invokes the Clicknow app, so you still need to have Clicknow installed and activated. I built the extension because many PopClip users asked for it, which is understandable as they only want one popup.

PopClip extension provides the two main features of Clicknow: explain, translate. But the Clicknow app has several features that the extension doesn't cover:

  • Spell check
  • Add date/time to calendar
  • Flight tracking when selecting a flight number

If you don't use these features, then you can pretty much use the extension or native app interchangeably. For me, I prefer to use the app directly because I heavily use the spell checker.

Encountered any issue? Don't hesitate to let me know.

title: Clicknow's Roadmap: 1.14 ~ 2.1
summary: Enhanced AI-search, two-way translation, custom prompts, and screenshot mode
author: laike9m
body_html:
Here's the planned roadmap for Clicknow, from 1.4 to 2.1

Ver 1.14 - Enhanced AI-search

Clicknow can search online, but in many cases the result is still directly returned from LLM without online data. I want to make it work more reliably, so that online data is included in the result when available.

Note: online-search requires accessing perplexity.ai. Not being able to access the website will disable this feature.

Ver 1.15 - Two-way Translation

This feature is asked by many non-English speaking users.

The end state will be like this: you can set a first (your native language) and second language (most likely English)

  • If the selected text is not in your first language, it will be translated to your first language;
  • If the selected text is in your first language, it will be translated to the second language.

let's say I'm a native Chinese speaker, I can set my first language as Chinese, and second language as English. Then, I can first write something in Chinese, and let Clicknow translate it into English, which it currently can't do.

Ver 2.0 - Custom Prompts

This is probably the most asked feature, and admittedly a significant change.

The current workflow and UX will NOT change. A third button will be added so you can enter custom prompts. You will also be able to store common prompts and select from them to avoid repetitive typing.

Details and UI is TBD. I will share more when ready.

Ver 2.1 - Screenshot Mode

Finally, explain or translate the text in a screenshot is also what many people want to use Clicknow for. I was a bit hesitant at first, but ultimately thought it would be really useful, so I decided to put it here.

Final Words

After 2.1, I believe Clicknow will (by and large) be feature complete. Of course, there will always be new requests and bug fixes, which I will be working on. However, Clicknow will not evolve into a full-featured LLM client, that is not the goal. It will always be a lightweight, non-interruptive, use-and-forget tool, that is there when you're too lazy to switch to another app. If you need to dig deep into something, a LLM client is a better choice.

title: Privay, privacy, and privacy
author: laike9m
body_html:
In Clicknow, user privacy is paramount.

What Information Does Clicknow Collects?

When you click the search or translate button, only the selected text is sent to Clicknow's server. We don't collect device info, IP, or any other personal Identifiable Information (PII).

Note, that the text is only sent upon clicking on the button, or pressing a shortcut. It is NOT sent when you highlight the text, so rest assured.

What Information Is Stored on Clicknow's Server?

The only information stored is user payment info and activation status.
Clicknow does NOT store user-selected text.

Can Clicknow Link Requests to A Specific User?

No. We authenticate requests in an anonymous way, making it impossible to link to a specific user even if we want to.

Have Concerns? Let Me Know

r/Clicknow

title: Clicknow vs Bob
summary: 对比一下同为 Mac 划词软件的 Clicknow 和 Bob 的异同
author: laike9m
body_html:
我经常被人问：Clicknow 和 Bob 有什么区别？今天我们来简单做个对比。

联网搜索

毫无疑问，Bob 是划词翻译领域的先驱和王者。如果你需要的是且只是翻译，那么我推荐直接使用 Bob。

Clicknow 的翻译效果很好（用的 Gemini 1.5），但它的强项更在于联网 AI 搜索。

比如，你听到一个播客叫《捕蛇者说》，你想知道这个主播 "laike9m" 是谁？无需离开当前页面，Clicknow 两秒钟就能告诉你答案：

而这个场景对 Bob 来说就显得有些吃力了。。

其它功能

除此之外，Clicknow 还提供了许多小功能，例如拼写检查、添加日历、计算器、航班追踪等等。

我个人最常用的毫无疑问是拼写检查，用上就很难离开了。比如你在 Telegram 里写 appropriate 这个词，但是错拼成了了 approprate（少了个 i）。使用 Telegram 内置的拼写检查，需要“右键点击 -> 选择 spelling -> 选择 approprate“ 才能修复：

而 Clicknow 只需双击一次：

至于划词添加日历，目前没有其它 app 能做到：

总结

Bob 将划词翻译做到了极致，而 Clicknow 则更为全面，选择哪款软件就看你的需求了。当然，一起用也是完全 OK 的。

title: Clicknow vs Dictionary, Perplexity, Apple Intelligence, PopClip
summary: How Clicknow is different from other tools, and why you might pick Clicknow over them
author: laike9m
body_html:
Clicknow vs Dictionary

Compared to dictionary, Clicknow let you access the world's knowledge, no matter if it's an academic term or the latest slang.

Clicknow vs Perplexity

Clicknow and Perplexity both provides online AI-search features. What sets Clicknow apart from Perplexity is its seamless integration and ease of use. Unlike Perplexity which is a standalone website, Clicknow works within any app you're using. With just one click, you can get an instant explanation of selected text in your preferred language - no need to copy text, open a new browser tab, and paste the text. This makes it incredibly convenient for quick translations, research while reading PDFs, browsing the web, or using any other app.

Clicknow vs Apple Intelligence

While Apple Intelligence focuses on AI-assisted writing, Clicknow is designed for instant searches and explanations. With Clicknow, you can quickly get detailed information about any term or phrase you come across, without disrupting your workflow. Its AI-powered search provides accurate, real-time explanations with additional context, giving you a deeper understanding of the selected text. In contrast, Apple Intelligence primarily offers writing suggestions and assistance, making it less suitable for on-the-spot research and translations.

Clicknow vs PopClip

Everyone loves PopClip. When it comes to extensibility, PopClip is the best.

Clicknow tries to do one thing and one thing really well: AI-search. While you can use PopClip to Google the selected text, it's still one step away in a new browser tab. With Clicknow, you can get the information you need while staying in your current app, without being interrupted, and no need to switching between apps.
